hero_subtitle: Passport, consular card, certificates, legalizations: submit your file online, pay from your phone and follow every step.
marquee_label: Land of vodun, kingdoms and lagoons
services_title: What the consulate does for you
service_passport_desc: Issuance or renewal of your Beninese passport.
service_card_desc: Proof of your nationality and residence abroad.
service_legalization_desc: Certificates, diplomas and certified true copies.
service_attest_desc: Residence, financial support, non-scholarship, proof of life.
discover_intro: From the palaces of Abomey to the lagoons of Ganvié, from Pendjari to the beaches of the Fishermen's Road: Benin tells its story through its places.
step_1_desc: Required documents and fees are shown before you start.
step_2_desc: One form, your documents as photos or scans. Nothing else.
step_3_desc: Mobile Money or bank card. A receipt is sent to you.
step_4_desc: A file number, an e-mail at each step, and an appointment if you need to come in.
cta_title: Some procedures require you to be there.
cta_text: Book a slot and you will be received without waiting.
footer_emblem_alt: Coat of arms of the Republic of Benin
contact_page_intro: The honorary consulate of Benin in Brazzaville welcomes you in Poto-Poto. Write or call before you visit.
contact_map_note: Marker placed on Rue Faignond (formerly Rue Mbakas). Approximate position.
network_intro: Two consulates serve you in Congo. Choose the one closest to you.

form_intro: We reply by e-mail. Please do not send ID documents or files through this form.
form_privacy: Your data is only used to reply to your message.
form_ok_text: Thank you. We will reply to the address you gave as soon as possible.
form_err_message: Your message must be between 10 and 2000 characters.
form_err_generic: Sending failed. Please try again, or e-mail us directly.
